description: Schema for deterministic per-file Lean4-vs-clean frontend run comparison artifacts consumed by generate_frontend_classification.py. The generator treats absent artifacts as missing evidence and present artifacts that violate this schema or disagree with the referenced per-engine artifacts as stale_or_invalid evidence.

field_constraints.engine: must equal lean4_vs_clean and match the path engine segment
field_constraints.filename: must equal the corpus filename, including .lean
field_constraints.source_sha256: must equal the current sha256: digest from tests/lean4_compat/MANIFEST.json
field_constraints.command: must be a non-empty array of non-empty strings describing the cross-check command or generator check
field_constraints.lean4_artifact_path: must reference the validated Lean4 per-engine artifact used for comparison
field_constraints.clean_artifact_path: must reference the validated clean per-engine artifact used for comparison
field_constraints.comparison_status: must match the referenced artifacts, for example exit_status_match_first_error_signature_mismatch
field_constraints.lean4_status: must match the referenced Lean4 artifact status
field_constraints.clean_status: must match the referenced clean artifact status
